tablet.notes:
Settings > Layout is its own screen (Layout, Dock side now with Bottom, Theme); Automatic uses the dock.
Settings > Resize screens: slide the divider for Chats, Groups or Calls, with Reset to default.
Hold a chat or group > Add to home screen.
The Message+ circle is only on the main chat screen; Dedication is gone; split screen options only show in a tablet layout.
A message read on the flip phone leaves the tablet's notifications.
